correctness.rationale: All six rank minors and all three commutator coefficients are derived directly and individually verified. When any middle d-coordinate is nonzero, wedge dependence forces the a- and f-tuples to vanish, yielding an irreducible product of determinantal hypersurfaces. When all d vanish, pointwise rank <=1 forces one of two mutually exclusive types at each index. Mixed nonzero types span opposite orthogonal lines in a two-dimensional nondegenerate pairing, yielding closed irreducible P1 incidence images. Generic noncontainment proves the exact \(2^t+1\) components, of dimensions \(3t\) and \(2t+1\). A disjoint arithmetic stratification establishes the finite-field formula for all prime powers. Literal finite-field matrix programs independently reproduce eleven counts including GF(4), with component-cover and unique-witness tests in two cases. Computational tests are not used as a proof of the theorem.

value.rationale: This is a natural smallest nontrivial rank-one section of the well-studied strictly upper-triangular commuting variety. It completely classifies its components in every arity, with the significant phenomenon that natural rank restriction increases the 4x4 commuting-pair component count from the ambient two to five, while mixed support strata generate \(2^t+1\) components and non-equidimensionality for every \(t\ge2\). The same geometric mechanism yields a uniform all-prime-power tuple count, a natural exact commuting invariant. The classification is neither a renamed ambient pair result nor an arbitrary numerical slice.
